body:
✅ Core Features
Safe random teleportation with multiple safety checks
Multi-world support with per-world configurations
Cooldown and warmup systems with movement cancellation
Economy integration (Vault support)
Permission-based access control

✅ Advanced Features (v1.1.0)
Update Checker: Automatic notifications for new versions
Metrics Integration: Built-in bStats support
Biome Restrictions: Allow/forbid specific biomes
Structure Avoidance: Avoid teleporting near dangerous structures
World Border Respect: Stay within world boundaries
Async Processing: Non-blocking location finding
Enhanced Safety: Multiple layers of safety checks

✅ Administrative Features
Comprehensive admin commands (/simplertp)
Configuration reload without restart (simple
Detailed plugin information display
Debug mode for troubleshooting

🎮 Commands
Command	| Description	                        |Permission

/rtp	| Teleport to a random location	        |overrtp.use
/overrtp| reload	Reload plugin configuration |overrtp.admin
/overrtp| info	Show plugin information	        |overrtp.admin
/overrtp| version	Show plugin version	        |overrtp.admin
